name: AIT Austrian Institute of Technology
notes: No JSON-LD on the live page despite the tier note (only a BreadcrumbList); the events list is a jQuery 'load more' widget hitting /index.php?id=2580&tx_aitnewsfeatures_newsapi[...]. Only 3 upcoming events exist on the site at build time -- confirmed genuine (amount=100 still returns 3), not a scraper bug. Teaser gives a coarse day/month range plus a unix timestamp (= the END date); scrape.py combines those for start/end and then enriches from each detail page's free-text 'Datum:'/'Ort:'/'Veranstaltungsort' phrasing for a precise start time and venue where the site states one. No category or price is ever published.
